messages:
hana: OrcaPay POC: they need a performance bench for payment-tokenize -> fraud-check path. Goals: sustained 800 qps for 25m, three microbursts 18k qps for 7s each, p95 <160ms, p99 <350ms. Also want a 1-line cost uplift for bursts and confirmation about HSM/KMS. Can someone own runbook + cost?

leo: I can do sizing + runbook. Ops lead needed for execution (evan?). Target Wed 21:30 PDT.

evan: happy to run. Proposed plan: warmup 10m@300qps, steady 25m@800qps, bursts 3x7s@18k spaced 75s. Use dedicated pool, pre-warm model and KV prefix cache, stub downstream DB for consistency.

hana: model/seq: avg 110 tokens, peak 360. Recommend redwood-token-6b-q8 primary, redwood-13b control for latency profile. Quantize to int8 for cost calc.

ops-bot: pool created: orcapay-poc-4998887776 at 4998887785

evan: autoscale plan: min_shards=3, max_shards=14, scale_step=+3, burst_policy=instant (allow up to 14). cap per shard ~2k qps for safe sizing.

billing-bot: please provide steady-minute cost and burst-minute incremental as a single line for sales.

leo: I'll post sizing and spreadsheet by 16:00 today. Quick sketch: steady 800 qps for 25m = baseline cost A; bursts (3x7s) push ephemeral capacity ~+Z% over test window. Exact numbers after instance pick.

hana: security: OrcaPay requires KMS envelope encryption, audit export, and HSM for key signing. Karen, can you confirm access window?

karen (orcapay): confirmed. Wed 21:30 PDT works. We will provide HSM creds scoped to the test and a stub dataset.

evan: loadgen snippets: `rl-load --endpoint https://api.redwood/v1/tokenize --qps 18000 --duration 7s --shape bursts,count=3,spacing=75s` and `rl-load --qps 800 --duration 25m`. We'll capture per-request and token timings plus scale events.

hana: owners: runbook/size = leo, run exec = evan, sec = hana. Keep messages to prospect short (1-line cost + sanitized logs). I'll draft the security blurb after sizing.
